title: Roti (Chapati)
description: Everyday whole-wheat flatbread, cooked on a tawa and puffed over an open flame. The default carb at almost every North Indian meal.
steps: In a large bowl, mix the flour and salt. Add water gradually, kneading until you get a soft, smooth dough. Cover and rest for 15-20 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal balls. Roll each ball in dry flour and roll out into a thin, even circle, about 6 inches across.
Heat a tawa (flat griddle) on medium-high heat. Place the rolled roti on it and cook for about 20-30 seconds until small bubbles appear, then flip.
Cook the second side for another 30 seconds, then use tongs to lift the roti directly onto an open flame (or press with a cloth on the tawa) until it puffs up.
Remove and brush lightly with ghee if using. Stack in a covered container to keep warm and soft. Repeat with the remaining dough.
